ai_summary: Banco Products (India) Limited has appointed Mr. Kshitikesh Parmeshwar as its new Chief Technology Officer, effective September 14, 2026. This is a material positive development, as Mr. Parmeshwar brings over 30 years of extensive experience in R&D, product innovation, and engineering leadership within the automotive and thermal management domains, including developing patented technologies. The appointment signals a strategic focus on technological advancement and innovation for the company, with no apparent red flags.
